name: JourneyFuse
description: All-in-one CRM for travel advisors and small agencies, "from first inquiry to paid-in-full": client journeys, trip/booking tracking, client comms, payments, replacing "a dozen disconnected tools." $25/mo. Founded Mar 2026, US.

mentions.evidence: ~$8,188 MRR, 405 active subscriptions, ~$16,761 L30 (L30 above MRR, so likely annual prepayments or onboarding fees, my inference), ~$48,787 all-time. Revenue synced Oct 6, 2026 ~06:37 Warsaw (04:37 UTC). TrustMRR "estimated users" 2,800 (founder-stated).
mentions.indieAngle: $25/mo vertical CRM for a profession of independent agents who share a host/franchise (insurance agents, mortgage brokers, wedding planners, real-estate agents under one broker). Sell through the host network, not ads.

whyItPrints: Vertical CRM for an old-school profession (host-agency travel advisors) that ran on spreadsheets and email. Seven months old with 405 paying subs, and +28.3% L30 MRR growth. A cheap price point in a tight-knit niche seems to spread fast (my read of the growth; acquisition channel not disclosed).
whyThisMatters:
Travel advisors keep the inquiry, the trip, the proposal, the itinerary, the payment, and the commission in one place. One monthly price covers the product, with a 30-day trial. JourneyFuse Lite is the smaller cut, for agencies that need commissions and card charges across a group of advisors.

Paste a supplier quote. It pulls dates, hotels, prices, and photos into a branded proposal. The client compares, approves, and pays a deposit. Disney, cruise, and Universal trips get their own checklists. A Disney dining alert emails you when a table matches the party. You still book that table with Disney.

They say more than 4,000 advisors and more than 550 agencies use it. The company started in the US in March 2026.
